title: tessera.brief/1
description: A context-budgeted digest of a catalog, for agents that cannot afford ~30k tokens of reference material. Carries everything needed to place an asset and nothing else. Roughly 8% of the catalog's size; sufficiency is asserted by a test that assembles a full scene from a brief and validates it against the source catalog.

id_prefix.description: Restores full asset ids from the shortened per-entry names. Carried rather than reconstructed, because the namespace is not always the kit id.

fingerprint.description: Identifies the exact catalog this was derived from. A layout composed against this brief should record it, so a mismatch at execution time is refused rather than silently accepted.

how_to_place.description: The placement rules in prose, because a digest with no instructions costs an agent more than it saves.

stack.description: Named world heights, precomputed so nobody adds them up.

mates.description: The connector compatibility table, carried once rather than per asset.

tolerance.description: Defaults. Assets override per connector only where they differ.

c.description: Field order of the packed connector arrays.

omitted.description: What was dropped and how to recover it.

id.description: Short name; prefix with id_prefix for the full id.

base.description: world_z = support_top + base. Present even when zero, because an absent field invites an assumption.

on.description: Connector kinds this asset may rest on.

datum.description: Ground this connector's plane rather than the asset's lowest point.
